help.find-process-mode: always forces matching on every process; strict lets the core decide; off never matches processes, recommended on routers.
help.allow-lan: When enabled, other devices on the LAN can reach this machine's proxy ports — make sure the network is trusted.
help.external-controller: RESTful API listen address, used by external dashboards to manage the core.
help.secret: Access key for the external controller. Leaving it empty lets anyone reach the control API — setting it is strongly recommended.
help.authentication: Format is "username:password", used for HTTP/SOCKS inbound authentication.
help.tcp-concurrent: When enabled, TCP dials every resolved IP concurrently and keeps whichever connection completes its handshake first.
help.hosts: Similar to /etc/hosts: pins a fixed resolution for a domain. A value can be a single IP, a list of IPs, or the special value "lan" (every local network interface's address).
